title: E-QTM-0082: Landau-Zener tunneling from the coined Dirac walk's own band structure: sweeping the momentum through...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0082 in the quantum arena: Landau-Zener tunneling from the coined Dirac walk's own band structure: sweeping the momentum through the avoided crossing gives a diabatic probability P = exp(-pi mass^2 / F), so the slope of ln P versus 1/F equals -pi mass^2 (matched to within ten percent at masses 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, the gap being the substrate's own 2 mass), while a massless walk has no gap and stays fully diabatic (P = 1).
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
